name: reliance_vs_ril_subsidiaries_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus-agent-3
thesis: Reliance Industries (RIL) is a conglomerate with value derived from O2C (petrochemicals), Jio Platforms (telecom/digital), and Retail. Since Jio Financial Services (JFSL) was demerged and listed separately (Aug 2023), the intraday return correlation between RIL and JFSL provides a tradeable pairs opportunity. Both stocks share common ownership, investor base, and macro sensitivity (Ambani group sentiment). When RIL moves sharply but JFSL doesn't follow (or vice versa), the divergence reverts within 30-60 minutes because: (1) group sentiment contagion — positive/negative sentiment about Reliance group affects both, (2) portfolio rebalancers who hold both adjust allocations intraday, (3) retail traders treat them as substitutes. The pair has 0.55-0.65 daily correlation but higher intraday (0.45-0.55 on 1-min returns), providing a mean-reverting spread.
stock_filter: RELIANCE: ADV > ₹2000 crore. JIOFIN: ADV > ₹200 crore

other: Brent crude oil price (RIL O2C sensitivity)

indicators.name: pair_spread
indicators.formula: ril_return_cum - beta * jfsl_return_cum where beta = rolling_regression_beta(RELIANCE, JIOFIN, 60)

conditions: spread_zscore < -2.0 (RIL underperforming JFSL relative to beta — expect RIL catch-up)
no RIL-specific or JFSL-specific news today
no RIL-specific or JFSL-specific news today

entry.entry_price: market order both legs: long underperformer + short outperformer

exit.signal_exit: RIL-specific or JFSL-specific news breaks during trade

filters.time_filter: no trades in first 15 min or last 15 min
filters.volume_filter: both stocks trading at > 0.7x normal volume
filters.trend_filter: no trend filter (pairs are market-neutral by construction)
filters.spread_filter: both stocks bid-ask < 5 bps (RELIANCE always tight; JIOFIN may be wider)
filters.event_filter: skip on RIL/JFSL AGM day, result day, or Ambani group news days
other_filters: skip if Brent crude moves > 2% intraday (RIL O2C segment drives independent movement)

edge.edge_decay_risk: Medium — as JFSL matures and develops its own identity, the correlation with RIL may decline, weakening the pairs signal. The pair is relatively new (post-demerger Aug 2023) with limited history.

weaknesses: JFSL is a newly listed stock (Aug 2023) with limited trading history. Beta estimates and correlation assumptions are based on sparse data and may be unreliable.
RIL's stock price is driven by O2C (oil), Jio (telecom), and Retail — three very different businesses. JFSL is pure financial services. The fundamental link weakens over time.
JFSL's liquidity is significantly lower than RIL's, creating asymmetric slippage between the two legs.
prior_art: Gatev, Goetzmann & Rouwenhorst (2006) 'Pairs Trading: Performance of a Relative-Value Arbitrage Rule'. In Indian context, conglomerate pair trades are common among prop desks. Tata group pairs (TCS-Tata Motors) are frequently cited examples.
notes: If RIL demerges more businesses in the future (e.g., Jio Platforms IPO, Retail IPO), additional pair opportunities will emerge. Monitor SEBI filings for potential demerger announcements. The beta between RIL and JFSL should be re-estimated daily.
